info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to irrigate, to wet, to sprinkle, to urinate

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: sIMcanA, gIlA karanA,prokzaRa karanA, peSAba karanA

examples: 'rajaH pramehAnnArIRAM mAsi mAsi viSuDyati. sarvaM SarIraM dozASca na pramehantyataH striyaH' (mADava0 33.36 ityatra maDukoSavyAKyAnAmudDftam). prameharogeRa na grasyanta ityAha.
'striyaM dAsImaDimehayatAM pUrvaH sAhasadaRqaH' (kO0 a0 2.36.41). aDimehayatAmaDicaratAmanAryaM vyavaharatAm mETunyamAcaratAm.
'devI devayajanI sA dIkzitena nABimihyA' (=nABimehyA) (Sa0 brA0 3.2.2.20). tasyA upari dIkzito na mehet na mUtrayet.
